scholarships.title: ICSSR Participation in International Seminar Abroad (Travel Grant Scheme)
scholarships.degree: Doctoral, Postdoctoral, Research (faculty and doctoral/postdoctoral scholars)
scholarships.official_source: Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), Ministry of Education, Government of India

existing.description: This scheme gives partial financial assistance to Indian social science scholars who have been formally invited to present a paper at an international conference abroad. Assistance covers air travel, visa fee, travel insurance, local conveyance, maintenance for the stay, and registration fee up to US$200. Regular faculty receive up to 50 percent of the total cost of the visit, while SC/ST faculty, persons with benchmark disability, and postgraduate/doctoral/postdoctoral researchers without salary protection may be considered for the full cost of the visit.
eligibility: Faculties with regular service in public funded Universities/Deemed-to-be-Universities/Colleges, Institutes of National Importance as defined by MoE / UGC, and ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognized Institutes having a PhD degree are eligible to apply.
Post-Graduate (Regular)/PhD/PDF scholars in Social Science disciplines who are in the advanced stage of their studies/research are eligible to apply.

Independent scholars having served as Civil servants, officers from Defence services, and other professionals with a social science perspective having not less than 20 years of regular service and demonstrable research experience through publications of books/research papers/reports/policy documents, etc. may also apply.
existing.eligibility_summary: Indian social science scholars in regular service at a UGC-recognized university/deemed university/college, an Institute of National Importance, or an ICSSR research or recognised institute, holding a PhD, or post-graduate/PhD/post-doctoral scholars at an advanced stage of study, or certain independent senior professionals.
benefits: Preference is given to younger scholars, scholars attending a conference or seminar for the first time, and scholars from remote and backward areas.

Invitations from global subject associations, reputed international organisations, universities or institutions are given preference, and due consideration is given to the peer review process used by the conference organisers.
coverage: Air travel (economy class, purchased through the three government approved travel agencies)
Maintenance costs for the period of stay abroad (not exceeding the actual days of the conference plus travel dates)

Up to 50 percent of the total cost of the visit for regular faculty; the full cost of the visit may be considered for SC/ST faculty, persons with benchmark disability and PG/doctoral/postdoctoral researchers without salary protection, and for faculties from ICSSR Research Institutes/Recognised Institutes
requirements: The application will be considered only when the paper for oral presentation has been accepted by the organiser of the Conference through a formal invite. A formal invitation letter should be submitted along with the application. A simple email will not be considered as a formal invite.
The submission of the full length paper to be presented is mandatory and it should be either in English or Hindi.

Applications should be uploaded at least three months before the due date of the Conference; the application will not be entertained or considered in any case after participation and presentation of the paper in the Conference.
If the paper is co-authored, priority will be given to the first author, but a No Objection Certificate(s) from the second author(s) may be procured and attached with the application.
Air tickets (economy class) must be purchased only from M/s Ashoka Travels and Tours (ATT), M/s Balmer Lawrie & Company Ltd (BLCL), or Indian Railways Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC).
Application for the second time will be considered only after a gap of three years, and a scholar can avail of the award only twice in his/her lifetime.
It is mandatory to buy tickets through the three government approved travel agencies; it is the scholar's own responsibility to arrange travel, visa and accommodation.
documents: Online application submitted through the ICSSR applicant portal at https://app.icssr.org/
Hard copy of the application with all documents, forwarded to: In-charge, ICG Division, Indian Council of Social Science Research, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, JNU Institutional Area, New Delhi 110067
Formal invitation letter from the Conference organiser (a simple email is not accepted)
Full-length paper to be presented, in English or Hindi
Detailed report on the work done related to the research
existing.english_requirement: The full length paper to be presented is mandatory and should be either in English or Hindi.
application_method: Obtain a formal written invitation to present an oral paper at the international conference.
Submit the online application at https://app.icssr.org/ at least three months before the Conference due date.
Send the hard copy of the application along with all documents to the In-charge, ICG Division, ICSSR, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, JNU Institutional Area, New Delhi 110067.
Applications are screened by the ICSSR Secretariat, then reviewed by an Expert Committee.
Expert Committee recommendations are placed before the Research Committee/Council for final approval.

After the visit, submit the original boarding pass, attendance certificate, statement of expenditure and a participation report duly forwarded by the Supervisor/Head of the Department/Centre, for reimbursement.
existing.selection_notes: Applications are initially scrutinised by the ICSSR Secretariat; an Expert Committee then reviews the applicant's research background, the quality of the paper to be presented and the academic credentials of the organising institution; recommendations go to the Research Committee/Council for final approval. The Council reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason and is not responsible for postal delays or loss.
existing.best_fit: Indian social science scholars (faculty, PhD scholars, postdocs, and some independent senior professionals) with a formally accepted oral paper at a high-value international conference outside India, who need help with the cost of attending.
existing.notes: Not deferrable: the application will not be entertained or considered in any case after participation and presentation of the paper in the Conference. Not renewable in the sense that a scholar can avail of the award only twice in his/her lifetime, and a second application is considered only after a gap of three years. No must-return-home rule is published because this is a travel grant, not a degree award. Post-award: expenditure is reimbursed on submission of the original boarding pass, attendance certificate, statement of expenditure and a report on participation; ICSSR may ask for a copy of the tickets booked and the visa obtained before departure. Publication is expected in high valued journals/edited books/impactful reports with due acknowledgement of ICSSR, and the paper presentation should clearly display the ICSSR logo and its support. A second time application is not considered for poster presentations, session chairs, conveners, rapporteurs, or workshop/training/refresher/summer/winter course attendance.
existing.duration: Period of stay abroad not exceeding the actual days of the conference plus travel dates
existing.application_period: Rolling - applications are submitted online throughout the year, and must be uploaded at least three months before the due date of the Conference.
existing.deadline_display: Applications can be submitted online throughout the year. The applications should be uploaded at least three months before the due date of the Conference.

scholarships.title: AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
scholarships.official_source: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India

existing.description: The Pragati Scholarship Scheme is implemented by the All India Council for Technical Education for girl students taking admission to AICTE-approved technical institutions at degree level. Each award is a lump sum of Rs 50,000 per year of study, given for up to four years for students admitted to the first year of a degree course and up to three years for degree students admitted through lateral entry. Eligibility is limited to female students from families with an annual income below Rs 8 lakh, with up to two girls per family eligible. The scheme is applied for through the National Scholarship Portal, which lists the award as open for academic year 2026-27 with student applications closing on 31 October 2026.
eligibility: Up to two girls per family
Family income below Rs 8 lakh per annum
Admitted to an undergraduate degree level programme or course in an AICTE-approved institution
Admitted in the first year of the degree course, or in the second year of the degree course through lateral entry
Renewal cases require continued admission in the subsequent year of the same course
existing.eligibility_summary: Girl students only, up to two per family, with family income below Rs 8 lakh per annum, admitted to the first year of an AICTE-approved undergraduate degree programme or to the second year through lateral entry. Renewal requires admission to the subsequent year of the same course.
benefits: Rs 50,000 per annum as a lump sum, not as a reimbursement of published fees
Payable for every year of study up to a maximum of 4 years for first-year degree entrants
Maximum of 3 years for degree students admitted through lateral entry
A separate Pragati scheme covers diploma level, with up to 3 years for first-year entrants and 2 years for lateral entry
coverage: Lump sum of Rs 50,000 per annum towards college fee
requirements: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal, which is the only route for the scheme
Have admission secured in an AICTE-approved institution for the academic year
Be a female student from a family with income below Rs 8 lakh per annum
For renewal, continue in the subsequent year of the same course
documents: Scanned mark sheet of Class X, Class XII or other qualification as applicable
Certificate issued by the Director, Principal or Head of the institute in the prescribed Annexure-I format
Annual family income certificate for the financial year, issued by the Tehsildar or equivalent competent authority, in the prescribed Annexure-II format
Admission letter to the degree course
Tuition fee receipt showing the tuition fee paid separately
Aadhaar-seeded bank pass book showing the student's name, account number, IFSC code and photograph
Attested caste certificate where reservation benefits are claimed
Signed declaration by the parents that the information is correct and that the amount will be refunded if found false
application_method: Complete a one-time registration on the National Scholarship Portal
Select the AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for girl students under the degree level when applying
Upload the prescribed documents and submit before the portal deadline
Have the institution verify the application during the portal's verification window
existing.selection_notes: The award is merit based. Admission to the AICTE-approved institution is governed by that institution's own admission criteria, and the scholarship is applied for separately after admission rather than being automatic on admission.
existing.best_fit: Girl students from families earning below Rs 8 lakh a year who have secured admission to an AICTE-approved undergraduate degree programme such as engineering, technology, management or pharmacy, and who need help with fees, books, equipment or a computer.
existing.notes: AICTE states that total scholarships of 10,000 are awarded at Rs 50,000 each per year. The award is explicitly not a full tuition waiver and the official eligibility text states that no additional grant is payable in lieu of hostel or medical charges. A separate diploma-level Pragati scheme exists and is a different award with different duration rules.
existing.duration: For every year of study: up to 4 years for first-year degree entrants and up to 3 years for degree entrants admitted through lateral entry
existing.application_period: Academic year 2026-27: scheme open from 1 June 2026, student applications open until 31 October 2026, with defective application, institute and district verification windows running to 15 and 30 November 2026
existing.deadline_display: 31 October 2026 for student applications for academic year 2026-27
existing.program_type: Government scholarship for women in technical education
